interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or mid-block crossing points to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Upgrade the painted bike lane with physical barriers like bollards or a concrete curb to better protect cyclists and create a buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Planting street trees or installing large planters would create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Installing speed humps would physically reduce vehicle speeds on this residential block, improving safety for all users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to provide space for a buffered bike lane or a wider sidewalk buffer/planting strip.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and remove encroaching vegetation to ensure a clear, level walking surface.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks at the nearest intersections to provide designated safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repave and level the cracked sidewalk sections to ensure a safe and accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting along the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair cracked and patched pavement to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked mid-block crosswalk with appropriate signage if pedestrian demand warrants a formal crossing point.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or humps to physically slow vehicle traffic on this residential street.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, which also helps to naturally slow traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Traffic calming
interventions.description: Implement measures such as speed humps or curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential zone.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant, install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the intersection is accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Obstruction Management
interventions.description: Relocate the trash can and consolidate signage to a dedicated furniture zone to maintain a clear pedestrian through-zone.
